units.source_text: 正当此日，葵姬为鬼怪所迷，病得很厉害。

en.t: Just at this time, Lady Aoi was possessed by a spirit and became gravely ill.

units.source_text: 家中上下一切人等，都忧愁叹息。

en.t: Everyone in the household, high and low alike, was anxious and sighed in sorrow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子此时不便再东偷西摸，二条院也难得回去。

en.t: At this point Prince Genji could no longer slip about here and there, and he could scarcely return to Nijo as well.

units.source_text: 他平时虽然不甚热爱葵姬，但毕竟是身份高贵的正夫人，对她总是另眼看待。

en.t: Although he had never been deeply in love with Lady Aoi, she was after all his noble principal wife, and he always treated her as someone apart.

units.source_text: 尤其是她身上已经有喜，又加之患病，因此源氏公子特别担心。

en.t: Especially because she was already pregnant and had now fallen ill besides, Prince Genji was particularly worried.

units.source_text: 便延请高僧高道，在自己房室内做种种法事。

en.t: He therefore invited eminent monks and holy practitioners to perform various rites in his own chambers.

units.source_text: 由于法事的效力，关亡的法师说出了许多鬼魂与生灵[\[10\]](#part1338.html#m10)的名字来。

en.t: Through the power of the rites, the medium monk named many ghosts and living spirits[\[10\]](#part1338.html#m10).

units.source_text: 其中有一个魂灵，始终不肯附在替身童子[\[11\]](#part1338.html#m11)身上，而只管附在病人自己身上。

en.t: Among them was one spirit that stubbornly refused to possess the substitute child[\[11\]](#part1338.html#m11) and instead kept clinging only to the patient herself.

units.source_text: 虽然并未带来特别的痛苦，但是片刻不离。

en.t: Although it did not cause any special suffering, it would not leave her for even a moment.

units.source_text: 延请法力精深的修行者来驱除，也不见效。

en.t: Even when practitioners of profound spiritual power were summoned to drive it out, there was no effect.

units.source_text: 这个顽强的魂灵，看来不是寻常的了。

en.t: This tenacious spirit seemed to be no ordinary one.

units.source_text: 左大臣邸内的人历数源氏公子的情妇，这个那个地猜测。

en.t: The people in the Minister of the Left's residence counted through Prince Genji's lovers and made guesses about one woman and another.

units.source_text: 有几个人悄悄地相告：“六条妃子和二条院的紫姬等，公子特别宠爱，她们的妒恨自然最深，想必是她们的生魂了。”

en.t: Several people whispered to one another, "The Rokujo lady and Lady Murasaki at Nijo are especially favored by the prince, so their jealousy must naturally be deepest. Surely it is their living spirits."

units.source_text: 请易者占卜一下，也没有定论。

en.t: They also brought in a diviner to cast an oracle, but no firm conclusion emerged.

units.source_text: 虽说是鬼怪迷人，但葵姬并没有对人结下深仇重怨。

en.t: Though people said she was possessed by a spirit, Lady Aoi had never formed any deep enmity or bitter grudge against anyone.

units.source_text: 想来想去，只有她的已故的乳母，或者世世代代与他家结怨的鬼魂，有时乘人之危，隐约出现而已。

en.t: After thinking it over again and again, the only possibilities were her late nurse, or ghosts that had borne grudges against her family for generations, appearing faintly now and then when they could take advantage of her weakness.
